familyNotes.radius: One radius, 14px; Tailwind's rounded-* are its multiples.
familyNotes.shadow: A shadow says something floats over the page. What sits in the page has a border.
familyNotes.tracking: Letter-spacing. Headings are a little tighter than the text.

notes.background: The page. One step off white in light, so that white cards and fields read as such.
notes.foreground: Body text and headings on background, card, popover, surface and surface-hover.
notes.card: A card or a dialog that is not a Panel.
notes.primary: The neutral look's primary fill: ink on paper, inverted in dark. An accent sets it to its brand.
notes.muted: A quiet fill: a track, a skeleton, a tag.
notes.muted-foreground: Secondary text (descriptions, captions, a table's head, a tile's label) on background, card, surface, surface-hover and muted: 4.5:1 on each.
notes.accent: A hovered or highlighted menu item's ground. Not the accent presets: those are brand.
notes.destructive: A destructive action's fill or outline.
notes.border: Every hairline: a Panel's border at 70 %, rows apart at 40 %.
notes.ring: The base outline colour (outline-ring/50). Keyboard focus uses focus-ring.
notes.bg: EasyUI's page colour: the scrollbar's track.
notes.surface: Fields, buttons, rows, tiles. A Panel is surface at 50 % (25 % in dark) over background.
notes.surface-hover: A hovered row, item or outline button.
notes.surface-raised: A box nested in a panel: an example, a code line, a sidebar item chosen.
notes.border-hover: A field or a card's border under the pointer.
notes.border-subtle: The faintest divider, inside a raised box.
notes.text-primary: Strong text in EasyUI's components, on surface, surface-hover and surface-raised.
notes.text-secondary: A field's label and secondary text on surface and surface-raised.
notes.text-muted: Muted text on surface, surface-hover and surface-raised: 4.5:1 (EasyUI's own value was lower).
notes.text-subtle: The faintest text: placeholders, a disabled label, on surface. Dark on surface-hover is 4.44:1, the design's one known pair under 4.5:1.
notes.accent-subtle: A faint ink wash over a surface (EasyUI).
notes.accent-ring: An ink ring around a selected thing (EasyUI).
notes.pill-bg-scrolled: EasyUI's navbar pill once the page has scrolled; no ioiti-ui component reads it.
notes.pill-border-scrolled: EasyUI's navbar pill border once scrolled.
notes.pill-border-idle: EasyUI's navbar pill border at rest.
notes.focus-ring: The one keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px away, on every control but a text field. 3:1 on every surface. An accent sets it to its brand.
notes.positive: A gain or a success as text, with its sign or word: 4.5:1 on background, surface, surface-hover and surface-raised.
notes.negative: A loss or a failure as text, with its sign or word; ErrorText. 4.5:1 on every surface.
notes.warning: A warning as text, with its word. 4.5:1 on every surface.
notes.info: Information as text. 4.5:1 on every surface.
notes.chart-series: The one series of a chart. An accent sets it to its own hue.
notes.chart-positive: A bar or area of gain. A mark, not text: figures use positive.
notes.chart-negative: A bar or area of loss. A mark, not text: figures use negative.
notes.chart-muted: A mark set back: the rest, a fifth series, a baseline.
notes.chart-axis: A chart's axis lines and ticks.
notes.chart-compare-1: The first of up to four things compared on one chart. In order, never recycled: a fifth is chart-muted.
notes.chart-gain-1: A heatmap's smallest gain; recedes toward the card (the cell's figure is in its tooltip).
notes.chart-gain-4: A heatmap's largest gain. Teal, not emerald: emerald and red's pale steps look alike to deuteranopes.
notes.chart-funnel-1: A funnel's first (widest) stage: one hue, its lightness stepping 0.06–0.09 a stage.
notes.chart-funnel-5: A funnel's last stage; the only one that may recede (2.5:1 on the card).
notes.code-keyword: Code highlighting: keywords. Every code colour is 4.5:1 on the editor's surface.
notes.code-selection: A code editor's selected text ground.
notes.violet-brand: Violet: the fill of what is chosen, current or primary (a filled button, a checked box, the page in the menu, a progress). With [data-accent="violet"] it is brand, primary and focus-ring.
notes.violet-brand-foreground: Violet: text and icons on violet-brand, 4.5:1 on it.
notes.violet-brand-soft: Violet: the tint of a chosen row, item or range.
notes.violet-brand-text: Violet: the accent as text (links, the current page) on every surface and on violet-brand-soft, 4.5:1.
notes.violet-brand-glow: Violet: a coloured shadow, under a primary button in glass.
notes.violet-brand-wash: Violet: the accent's colour in the glass backdrop's first wash.
notes.violet-brand-reflection: Violet: the accent's colour in a far corner of a glass surface.
notes.violet-brand-tile-glow: Violet: the glow of a glass tile (KpiTile), from a corner that changes from tile to tile, in light only; transparent in dark. About half its wash: grey text keeps 4.5:1 where it is strongest.
notes.violet-chart-series: Violet: the one series of a chart.
notes.indigo-brand: Indigo: the fill of what is chosen, current or primary (a filled button, a checked box, the page in the menu, a progress). With [data-accent="indigo"] it is brand, primary and focus-ring.
notes.indigo-brand-foreground: Indigo: text and icons on indigo-brand, 4.5:1 on it.
notes.indigo-brand-soft: Indigo: the tint of a chosen row, item or range.
notes.indigo-brand-text: Indigo: the accent as text (links, the current page) on every surface and on indigo-brand-soft, 4.5:1.
notes.indigo-brand-glow: Indigo: a coloured shadow, under a primary button in glass.
notes.indigo-brand-wash: Indigo: the accent's colour in the glass backdrop's first wash.
notes.indigo-brand-reflection: Indigo: the accent's colour in a far corner of a glass surface.
notes.indigo-brand-tile-glow: Indigo: the glow of a glass tile (KpiTile), from a corner that changes from tile to tile, in light only; transparent in dark. About half its wash: grey text keeps 4.5:1 where it is strongest.
notes.indigo-chart-series: Indigo: the one series of a chart.
notes.blue-brand: Blue: the fill of what is chosen, current or primary (a filled button, a checked box, the page in the menu, a progress). With [data-accent="blue"] it is brand, primary and focus-ring.
notes.blue-brand-foreground: Blue: text and icons on blue-brand, 4.5:1 on it.
notes.blue-brand-soft: Blue: the tint of a chosen row, item or range.
notes.blue-brand-text: Blue: the accent as text (links, the current page) on every surface and on blue-brand-soft, 4.5:1.
notes.blue-brand-glow: Blue: a coloured shadow, under a primary button in glass.
notes.blue-brand-wash: Blue: the accent's colour in the glass backdrop's first wash.
notes.blue-brand-reflection: Blue: the accent's colour in a far corner of a glass surface.
notes.blue-brand-tile-glow: Blue: the glow of a glass tile (KpiTile), from a corner that changes from tile to tile, in light only; transparent in dark. About half its wash: grey text keeps 4.5:1 where it is strongest.
notes.bloom-brand: Bloom: the fill of what is chosen, current or primary (a filled button, a checked box, the page in the menu, a progress). With [data-accent="bloom"] it is brand, primary and focus-ring.
notes.bloom-brand-foreground: Bloom: text and icons on bloom-brand, 4.5:1 on it.
notes.bloom-brand-soft: Bloom: the tint of a chosen row, item or range.
notes.bloom-brand-text: Bloom: the accent as text (links, the current page) on every surface and on bloom-brand-soft, 4.5:1.
notes.bloom-brand-glow: Bloom: a coloured shadow, under a primary button in glass.
notes.bloom-brand-wash: Bloom: the accent's colour in the glass backdrop's first wash.
notes.bloom-brand-reflection: Bloom: the accent's colour in a far corner of a glass surface.
notes.bloom-brand-tile-glow: Bloom: the glow of a glass tile (KpiTile), from a corner that changes from tile to tile, in light only; transparent in dark. About half its wash: grey text keeps 4.5:1 where it is strongest.
notes.bloom-brand-wash-2: Bloom: the glass backdrop's second wash, the flyer's tangerine. Never a mark's or a text's colour.
notes.bloom-brand-wash-3: Bloom: the glass backdrop's third wash, the flyer's mustard. Never a mark's or a text's colour.
notes.bloom-gradient-1: Bloom: the gradient's first stop (lilac), at 0 % of a 110deg linear gradient, under the grain. A filled primary button and the app mark only.
notes.bloom-gradient-2: Bloom: the gradient's middle stop (pink), at 50 %.
notes.bloom-gradient-3: Bloom: the gradient's last stop (tangerine), at 100 %.
notes.bloom-brand-fill-foreground: Bloom: text on the gradient, the dark page's ink in both themes, 4.5:1 on every point of it.
notes.bloom-chart-series: Bloom: the one series of a chart.
notes.glass-base: Glass: the page under the washes.
notes.glass-tint-1: Glass: the backdrop's first wash, top left (an accent replaces it with its own).
notes.glass-tint-2: Glass: the backdrop's second wash, top right.
notes.glass-tint-3: Glass: the backdrop's third wash, bottom.
notes.glass-float: Glass: what floats (popovers, menus, dialogs, toasts, tooltips), blurred 20px, nearly opaque and without sheen: its grey text holds 4.5:1 with black (light) or white (dark) right behind it. Opaque white or #1c1c1f where less transparency is asked.
notes.glass-bar: Glass: the sidebar and the top bar, lightly blurred (14px).
notes.glass-card: Glass: a panel or a card, not blurred; a panel's edge is lit at its top (glass-edge).
notes.glass-frost: Glass: a figure's tile (KpiTile, glass-tile), frosted and blurred 24px; in light, lit from above. Opaque where less transparency is asked.
notes.glass-raised: Glass: a box nested in a panel (PanelInset), a faint tint of the panel: ink in light, black in dark (set into it, not lighter).
notes.glass-edge: Glass: the border of a glass surface.
notes.glass-hairline: Glass: the hairline ring outside a glass card.
notes.glass-highlight: Glass: the light on a glass surface's top edge.
notes.glass-shine: Glass: the light across a panel or a tile from its top corner, of a set size (520 × 260 px). Not on what floats.
notes.glass-shadow: Glass: the colour of a glass surface's deeper shadow.
notes.glass-scrim: Glass: a dialog's scrim, lighter than the flat one so the dialog's glass shows the page.
notes.glass-text-subtle: Glass: text-subtle a step stronger, 4.5:1 on glass over the strongest wash.
notes.glass-muted-foreground: Glass, light theme only: muted-foreground a step stronger. Dark glass keeps muted-foreground.
notes.glass-positive: Glass, light theme only: positive a step stronger.
notes.shadow-subtle: A control lifted a hair off its surface.
notes.shadow-elevated: What floats over the page: a dialog, a menu, a popover, a toast. What sits in the page has a border instead.
notes.glass-shadow-subtle: Glass: shadow-subtle under the glass material.
notes.glass-shadow-elevated: Glass: shadow-elevated under the glass material, deeper.
notes.radius: The one radius (14px). Every rounded-* class is a multiple of it, so changing it changes them all.
notes.radius-md: rounded-md, radius × 0.8: a small button (xs, sm), a menu item.
notes.radius-lg: rounded-lg, the radius itself: a button, a field, a nested box.
notes.radius-xl: rounded-xl, radius × 1.4: a popover, a menu, a dialog.
notes.radius-2xl: rounded-2xl, radius × 1.8: a Panel, a KpiTile.
notes.radius-full: rounded-full: a badge, a switch, an avatar, a pill.

spacing.name: spacing
spacing.usage: Tailwind's unit (4px): p-4 is 4 × spacing. Every padding and gap is a step of it.

spacing.name: page-padding
spacing.usage: A page's padding on a phone (p-4).

spacing.name: page-gap
spacing.usage: Between the blocks of a page (gap-6): the shell puts it there, a page adds no margins.

spacing.name: panel-padding
spacing.usage: A Panel's header and body padding (px-5 pt-5, p-5).

spacing.name: control-height
spacing.usage: A button or field at size md (h-10); sm is 32px (h-8), xs 24px (h-6), lg 48px (h-12).

spacing.name: page-max-width
spacing.usage: A page's column stops here (max-w-7xl) unless the page asks the shell to be wide.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: PageHeader's h1 (text-2xl tracking-tight). One a page.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A KpiTile's figure (text-xl, sm:text-2xl): proportional digits at this size.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The order was sent to the warehouse.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Captions, a table's head, a tile's label (text-xs text-muted-foreground).

styles.name: badge
styles.usage: A badge: the smallest text there is. Nothing goes under 11px.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Ids, keys, what is typed exactly (font-mono text-xs).

styles.name: code-block
styles.sample: const total = items.reduce((s, i) => s + i.amount, 0)
styles.usage: CodeBlock, LogViewer and the code editors.
